内容提要
这本连环画是根据古典神话小说《西游记》第四十七——四十九回编绘的。描述唐僧师徒在去西天取经途中，路过通天河，发现通天河里的妖怪危害当地百姓，吞吃童男童女。孙悟空为民除害，奋勇当先，大闹通天河。最后在观音菩萨的帮助下，降伏了妖怪——金鱼精，为百姓们解脱了灾难。
page_text_en:
Great Uproar at Tongtian River
Part Eighteen of "Journey to the West"
Original Author: Wu Cheng'en
Adapted by: Guo Fengming
Illustrated by: Liu Lingcang
Xuan Guan
Yin Chao
Hebei Fine Arts Publishing House
Synopsis
This illustrated book is adapted from chapters 47 to 49 of the classical mythological novel "Journey to the West". It describes how Tang Sanzang and his disciples, on their journey to the West to obtain scriptures, passed by Tongtian River and discovered that a monster in the river was harming local people and devouring young boys and girls. Sun Wukong, determined to rid the people of this menace, took the lead and caused a great uproar at Tongtian River. Finally, with the help of Guanyin Bodhisattva, he subdued the monster—the Golden Fish Demon—and freed the people from disaster.
summary_zh: 本页为《西游记》连环画第十八册《大闹通天河》的封面及内容提要，介绍了该册改编自原著第四十七至四十九回，讲述了唐僧师徒路过通天河，孙悟空降伏金鱼精为民除害的故事。

1 车迟国元会县陈家庄，紧靠一条大河，名叫通天河。不知道从哪里来了一个怪物，惯会呼风唤雨、兴风作浪，害得两岸百姓流离失所，年年遭灾。
2 后来那怪自称灵感大王，硬逼着百姓修建庙宇，用猪羊美酒祭祀，一年还要吃一对童男、童女。每当大祭，父母把自己儿女活活送给妖怪去吃，总是哭得十分悲惨。
page_text_en:
1 In Yuanhui County, Chechi Kingdom, there is a village called Chenjia Zhuang, right next to a big river called Tongtian River. A monster came from somewhere unknown, skilled in summoning wind and rain, stirring up waves, causing the people on both banks to be displaced and suffering disasters every year.
2 Later, the monster called himself Linggan King, forcing the people to build a temple, sacrificing pigs, sheep, and fine wine. Every year, he demanded a pair of boy and girl children. During each grand sacrifice, parents had to send their children alive to be eaten by the monster, always crying bitterly.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了通天河畔陈家庄因妖怪作乱而民不聊生的背景：妖怪呼风唤雨、兴风作浪，迫使百姓修建庙宇并每年献祭一对童男童女，场面悲惨。

3 这年秋天，唐僧师徒往西天取经，因为趁着月色多赶了路，直到听见水响，才知道一条大河拦住去路。
4 唐僧忙问能不能过去，猪八戒寻了一块鹅卵石往水里一抛，只听见咕咚一声响，沉入水底去了。八戒这一试，才知道水深不能渡过。
page_text_en:
3 In that autumn, Tang Sanzang and his disciples were journeying westward to fetch scriptures. Because they had hurried along under the moonlight, they didn't realize a great river blocked their path until they heard the sound of water.
4 Tang Sanzang hurriedly asked if they could cross. Zhu Bajie found a smooth stone and threw it into the water. They heard a 'plunk' and saw it sink to the bottom. After this test, Bajie realized the water was too deep to cross.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒在秋夜赶路时，发现一条大河挡住了去路。猪八戒投石试水，发现河水深不可渡。

5 悟空说：‘你能试出深浅，却试不出宽窄，等我看看！’
话音未落，一个筋斗便跳入云里，他只见远处水天一色，
白茫茫地望不见边。
6 悟空急收云头，按落河边，把察看的结果告诉唐僧，
唐僧听完急得一时说不出话来。
师父，过不去了。
老孙平日能看三
五百里，如今却
看不到岸边。
page_text_en:
5 Wukong said: 'You can test the depth, but not the width. Let me take a look!' 
Before the words had finished, he did a somersault and leapt into the clouds. He saw only the distant horizon where water and sky merged into one, 
endlessly white and boundless.
6 Wukong quickly retracted his cloud, landed by the riverbank, and reported his findings to Tang Sanzang. 
Tang Sanzang, upon hearing this, was so anxious he couldn't speak for a moment.
Master, we can't cross.
Usually, I can see three or five hundred li, but now I can't even see the riverbank.
summary_zh: 孙悟空为探通天河的宽窄，驾云飞上高空，发现河面广阔无边，无法看到对岸。他返回后向唐僧报告，唐僧听后焦急万分。

7 悟空看见旁边影影绰绰像个人影，提了铁棒跑过去一看，只见一块石碑，上面写着“通天河”三个大字，旁边还有十个小字：“河宽八百里，自古少行人。”
8 悟空忙叫唐僧来看，唐僧拉马过来一看，不禁滴泪说：“徒弟，我当年离了长安，只想西天好走，哪知妖魔拦路，山水迢遥，真是不知何年何月才能取经回来。”
page_text_en:
7 Wukong saw a vague figure nearby, grabbed his iron staff, and ran over. He saw a stone tablet with the three large characters "Tongtian River" and ten smaller characters beside it: "Eight hundred li wide, few travelers have passed since ancient times." 
8 Wukong hurriedly called Master Tang to come and see. Master Tang pulled his horse over, looked, and couldn't help shedding tears, saying: "Disciple, when I left Chang'an, I only hoped the journey to the West would be smooth. Who knew demons would block our path, the mountains and rivers so distant? I truly don't know when I'll be able to return with the scriptures."
summary_zh: 孙悟空发现通天河畔的石碑，上面刻有“河宽八百里，自古少行人”的警示。他叫来唐僧观看，唐僧见状悲从中来，感叹取经之路艰难险阻，不知何时能完成使命。

9 师徒四人正没主意，只听得远处有鼓钹声音，于是悟空领路寻着声音走去。月光下也难找到正路，大家没高没低地走了一程，才看见前面灯火照出一簇人家，约有一百来户。
10 村口一家人家，门口竖着幢幡，门里灯火辉煌，香烟袅绕。唐僧就把马交沙僧牵了，自己上前求告，想借宿一宵，明天找渡口过河。
page_text_en:
9 The four disciples were at a loss, when they heard the sound of drums and cymbals from afar. So Wukong led the way, following the sound. Under the moonlight, it was hard to find the right path. After walking a while, up and down, they finally saw a cluster of houses ahead, illuminated by lights, about a hundred households.
10 At the village entrance, a household had banners erected at the door, with bright lights inside and incense smoke curling. Tang僧 handed the horse over to Sha僧 to lead, and went forward himself to ask for lodging for the night, planning to find a ferry crossing the river tomorrow.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒在月夜下迷失方向，循着鼓钹声找到一村落，唐僧向村民求借宿一晚，准备次日寻找渡口过河。

11 唐僧在门口站了一会，只见一个老头念着佛走出来。唐僧连忙合掌问讯，说是自东土大唐而来，经过此地往西天取经的。老头一听连忙说：“有请！”
12 悟空、八戒、沙僧听说“有请！”牵马挑担一阵风似地闯了进来，老头见他们生得怪相，几乎吓倒，唐僧连忙扶住，仔细解释。
老施主不用怕，我老
这三个徒弟是相貌
人善，还问降妖擒
怪的本事呢！
page_text_en:
11 Tang Sanzang stood at the door for a while, when an old man chanting Buddhist scriptures came out. Tang Sanzang hurriedly clasped his hands in greeting, saying he had come from the Eastern Tang Dynasty, passing through this place on his way to the Western Heaven to fetch scriptures. The old man, upon hearing this, immediately said, "Please come in!"
12 Wukong, Baijie, and Sha Wujing, upon hearing "Please come in!", rushed in with their horse and luggage like a gust of wind. The old man, seeing their strange appearances, was almost frightened to fall. Tang Sanzang quickly held him up and explained carefully.
Don't be afraid, old master, I am old.
These three disciples may look strange,
but they are kind-hearted and even ask about the skills to subdue demons and capture monsters!
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒在陈家庄求宿，唐僧向一位念经的老头说明来意，老头热情相迎。当孙悟空、猪八戒、沙僧闯入时，老头被他们的相貌吓到，唐僧连忙解释，称他们虽相貌奇特但心地善良，且有降妖除怪的本事。

13 老头自己介绍叫陈清，随后把唐僧师徒四人让进厅房，厅房里原有一班和尚正在念经，一见悟空等进门，也吓得乱撞乱跑，把灯也撞翻了。
14 悟空拿起火把点灯，扶唐僧坐下；陈清又请出他哥哥陈澄来和唐僧师徒相见，又安排斋饭款待唐僧师徒四人，叫僮仆给唐僧喂马。
page_text_en:
13 The old man introduced himself as Chen Qing, then led the four disciples of Tang Sanzang into the hall. There were already a group of monks chanting scriptures in the hall, who, upon seeing Wukong and the others enter, were so frightened that they ran about wildly and knocked over a lamp.
14 Wukong took a torch to light the lamp and helped Master Tang sit down. Chen Qing then brought out his brother Chen Cheng to meet the Tang Sanzang and his disciples, arranged a vegetarian meal to entertain the four, and instructed the servants to feed Master Tang's horse.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒被陈清引入厅房，因孙悟空等相貌奇特，惊吓了正在念经的和尚。随后，孙悟空点灯扶唐僧坐下，陈清请出其兄陈澄相见，并安排斋饭款待师徒四人，命僮仆喂马。

我的食量大，要
二十个人服侍才行！
15 厅房的桌子上，摆满了斋饭。八戒跳上前拉住陈清
说自己吃得多，需要二十个人服侍。陈清虽然不信，却答应说：“有，有！”
添饭，添饭！
16 陈澄、陈清请唐僧师徒入席。唐僧一卷启斋经没有
念完，八戒那呆子早已五六碗下肚子。二十个人端饭、送
菜还嫌慢了，这一顿吃了将近一石面粉、五斗米。
page_text_en:
My appetite is huge, I need
twenty people to serve me!
15 The dining hall table was full of vegetarian food. Bajie jumped forward and grabbed Chen Qing, saying he ate a lot and needed twenty people to serve him. Although Chen Qing didn't believe it, he agreed, saying, "Yes, yes!"
More rice, more rice!
16 Chen Cheng and Chen Qing invited Master Tang and his disciples to the table. Before Master Tang finished reciting the opening prayer, Bajie had already eaten five or six bowls. Twenty people serving food and dishes were still too slow for him; he ate nearly one stone of flour and five dou of rice in one meal.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒在陈家庄用斋，猪八戒因食量大要求二十人服侍，陈清答应后，八戒一顿饭吃掉近一石面粉和五斗米，场面热闹而夸张。

17 吃罢斋，陈老又让唐僧师徒吃茶，唐僧这才问起刚才做的什么斋，两位老头见问，不禁伤心落泪说：‘是一场预修亡斋。’八戒在旁笑道：‘你家又没死人，修什么亡斋？’
18 陈清这才把灵感大王要吃童男、童女的事说了出来。今年大祭又轮到陈澄、陈清。陈澄老年得女，陈清老年得子，哪里舍得把亲生儿女送去。说到悲痛处，二人大哭起来。
page_text_en:
17 After finishing the meal, Old Chen offered Tang Sanzang and his disciples tea. Tang Sanzang then asked what kind of ceremony they had just held. The two old men, upon being asked, couldn't help but shed tears and said, 'It was a pre-arranged funeral ceremony.' Bajie laughed beside them, 'You haven't even lost anyone. Why hold a funeral ceremony?'
18 Only then did Chen Qing reveal that the Spirit King of Inspiration demanded child sacrifices. This year's grand sacrifice fell upon Chen Cheng and Chen Qing. Chen Cheng had a daughter in his old age, and Chen Qing had a son in his old age. How could they bear to send their own children? Speaking of their sorrow, the two men burst into tears.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒在陈家庄用斋后，唐僧询问斋事，陈家两位老人悲痛地说明这是为应对灵感大王索要童男童女而提前准备的‘亡斋’，陈清更详细讲述了自己与兄长因年老得子而痛心欲绝，无法忍受献出亲生儿女，二人因此大哭。

19 悟空听了早气得按捺不住，心想：别说什么大王，
就是玉皇大帝我也饶不了他。他见两位施主恸哭，忙上前
来拉住陈清，叫他把孩子抱出来看看。
20 陈清急入里面，将他的儿子陈关保抱出来放在厅前，
不由得又哭了起来。那小孩不知死活，还只顾跳着要果子
吃。
page_text_en:
You bring the child out so I can take a look.
19 Wukong, upon hearing this, was so angry he could not hold himself back. He thought: Forget about any king, even the Jade Emperor himself, I won't spare him. Seeing the two hosts weeping bitterly, he hurried forward, grabbed Chen Qing, and urged him to bring the child out to be seen.
20 Chen Qing rushed inside, brought out his son Chen Guanbao, and placed him in front of the hall, whereupon he couldn't help but cry again. The child, unaware of the danger, kept jumping and asking for fruit to eat.
summary_zh: 孙悟空听闻灵感大王索要童男童女后怒不可遏，要求查看被选中的孩子。陈清抱出儿子陈关保，自己悲痛哭泣，而孩子却不知危险，只顾着要果子吃。

21 悟空默默念咒，摇身一变，变得和关保一模一样。两个孩子搀着手，在灯前跳舞。陈清叫了声“关保！”两个孩子一齐答应。陈清又惊又喜，连声说：“请现本相，莫折了我的年寿！”
22 悟空一抹脸现了本相说：“老施主，我替关保祭祀，给你留一个根苗如何？”陈清一听，噗嗵跪在地下，只管磕起头来
page_text_en:
21 Wukong silently chanted a spell, transformed with a flick of his body, and became exactly like Guan Bao. The two children held hands and danced before the lamp. Chen Qing called out, “Guan Bao!” Both children answered together. Chen Qing was both surprised and delighted, exclaiming repeatedly, “Please reveal your true form, don’t shorten my life!”
22 Wukong wiped his face and revealed his true form, saying, “Old master, I’ll take Guan Bao’s place in the sacrifice. How about leaving you a descendant?” Upon hearing this, Chen Qing fell to his knees, bowing his head repeatedly.
summary_zh: 孙悟空变作陈关保的模样，与真孩子一同跳舞，陈清惊喜交加；随后孙悟空现出原形，提出代替陈关保祭祀，陈清感激涕零，跪地磕头。

23 这边陈清刚刚起来，那边陈澄依着屏门又哭起来，悟空上前扯住道：“你想是舍不得女儿，快去再蒸五斗米的饭，请那个长嘴师父，替你女儿祭祀去。”
24 八戒一听大惊道：“哥哥，你要显本事，可不要扯攀我，变化的事情我可不会！”陈澄一听哪里肯信，早跪在八戒面前求告起来。
page_text_en:
23 On one side, Chen Qing had just stood up, while on the other, Chen Cheng leaned against the screen door and began to cry again. Wukong stepped forward and grabbed him, saying, "You must be reluctant to part with your daughter. Go quickly and steam five dou of rice, and invite that long-mouthed master to sacrifice in your daughter's place."
24 Bajie, upon hearing this, was greatly startled and said, "Brother, if you want to show off your skills, don't drag me into it—I can't do transformations!" Chen Cheng, upon hearing this, wouldn't believe it and immediately knelt before Bajie, begging him.
summary_zh: 孙悟空提出由自己代替陈澄的女儿祭祀灵感大王，陈澄悲痛欲绝；猪八戒听后惊慌，表示自己不会变化，陈澄则跪地向八戒求告。

summary_zh: 唐僧师徒踏冰过河，孙悟空在前引路，妖怪在冰下跟随。快到河心时，妖怪破冰，唐僧、猪八戒、沙僧和白马行李坠入水中，孙悟空跳入空中幸免落水。

那唐僧在哪里？

在宫后石匣里，他徒弟小呆刚就煮吃了。

师父放心，等老孙先来捉怪！
page_text_en:
53 Wukong searched the two wings for a while but couldn't find his master. Suddenly, a large-bellied shrimp-woman came to the west corridor. Wukong jumped over and asked, and learned that his master was in a stone box behind the palace.

54 Wukong hurried to the back and indeed found a stone box, about six feet long, resembling a stone coffin. Wukong crouched beneath the stone box and listened carefully, hearing Tang Sanzang weeping softly inside.

Where is that monk?

In the stone box behind the palace, his disciple Xiaodai just boiled and ate him.

Master, don't worry, wait for me to come and catch the monster first!
summary_zh: 孙悟空在妖怪府邸寻找唐僧，从大肚虾婆处得知唐僧被关在宫后石匣中，他找到石匣并听见唐僧在里面哭泣，随即立誓要救出师父。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》
title_en: Journey to the West 18: The Great Uproar at Tongtian River
source_file: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
55 悟空急回头跳出宫来，见了沙僧、八戒说：‘正是那怪摄了师父。我不识水性，你二人前去叫战，能擒就擒，不能擒引他出水，等我来打。’沙僧答应道：‘哥哥放心，我二人见机行事就是。’
56 八戒和沙僧闯到门前高声叫骂，那怪闻听，立刻披挂停当，提了九瓣赤铜锤，引了百十个小妖，出门摆下阵势，要与八戒沙僧对打。
打不死的泼物！你认得一杆金吗？还我师父来！
有本事比一比，三合打胜还你师父，打败了连你一起吃！
page_text_en:
55 Wukong hurriedly turned and jumped out of the palace, seeing Sha Wujing and Zhu Bajie, and said: 'It is indeed that monster who has captured our master. I am not skilled in water, you two go and challenge him. If you can capture him, do so; if not, lure him out of the water, and I will fight him.' Sha Wujing replied: 'Brother, don't worry, we will act according to the situation.'
56 Bajie and Sha Wujing rushed to the gate and shouted insults. The monster, upon hearing this, immediately put on his armor, picked up his nine-petal bronze hammer, led a hundred or so small demons, and came out to set up battle formation, ready to fight Bajie and Sha Wujing.
You unkillable scum! Do you recognize this golden staff? Return our master to us!
If you have the courage, let's fight! If you win in three rounds, I'll return your master; if you lose, I'll eat you too!
summary_zh: 孙悟空从妖怪府邸探明情况后，与八戒、沙僧商议对策，决定由八戒和沙僧前去叫阵引出妖怪，孙悟空则在旁伺机而动。八戒和沙僧在门外高声叫骂，妖怪闻讯后披挂上阵，带领小妖出战，双方即将展开战斗。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》
title_en: Journey to the West 18: The Great Uproar at Tongtian River
source_file: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
57 沙僧听见那怪唠唠叨叨地胡说，气得忍无可忍，举起降魔宝杖就打，那怪也挥动赤铜锤架住，一时三人打在一起，直斗了两个时辰，还不分胜负。
58 八戒料想赢不了他，就对沙僧丢了个眼色，二人假装战败，拖了兵器回头就走；那怪挥动赤铜锤追赶出来。
page_text_en:
57 Sha Wujing, hearing the demon blabbering nonsense, became furious and could no longer bear it. He raised his magic staff to strike, and the demon blocked with his bronze hammer. The three of them fought fiercely, battling for two hours without a clear winner.
58 Pigsy, realizing he couldn't win, gave Sha Wujing a glance. The two pretended to be defeated, dragging their weapons and turning to flee. The demon swung his bronze hammer and chased after them.
summary_zh: 沙僧与妖怪激烈交战，不分胜负；猪八戒与沙僧假装战败撤退，引诱妖怪追击。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》
title_en: Journey to the West 18: The Great Uproar at Tongtian River
source_file: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
59 却说悟空正在岸边等得不耐烦，只见八戒和沙僧翻波掀浪，先后跳了出来，八戒说声“来了！”那怪早涌出水面，悟空抡起铁棒猛力打去。
60 那怪一闪身，躲过了第一棍，趁着浪势翻上翻下与悟空对打，悟空居高临下，抡动铁棒，一路猛打，那怪招架不住，赶忙跑了。
page_text_en:
59 While Wukong was waiting impatiently by the shore, he saw Bajie and Sha僧 splashing through the waves, jumping out one after another. Bajie shouted, "Here comes the monster!" The monster soon emerged from the water, and Wukong swung his iron staff and struck fiercely.
60 The monster dodged the first blow, then used the waves to flip up and down, fighting Wukong. Wukong, from a higher position, swung his iron staff and attacked fiercely. The monster couldn't withstand the assault and hurriedly fled.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在岸边等待，八戒和沙僧从水中跳出，妖怪现身，孙悟空挥棒猛击；妖怪闪避后与孙悟空对战，最终招架不住逃跑。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》
title_en: Journey to the West 18: The Great Uproar at Tongtian River
source_file: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
那是五百年前大
闹天宫的美猴王！
亏你跑得快，再打
性命都难保！
61 那怪逃回宫里，斑衣鳜婆问明底细，直吓得目瞪口
呆，半天才喘了一口气，把悟空的身世告诉给那怪。
62 那怪知道了孙悟空的厉害，急忙命众水族紧闭大门，
门里塞了泥沙土石；八戒和沙僧二次回来叫骂打门，那怪
只是不理。
page_text_en:
That's the Monkey King who caused chaos in Heaven five hundred years ago!
You're lucky you ran fast, or you'd be dead!
61 The monster fled back to the palace. The spotted perch woman asked for details, and was so frightened she stared blankly, gasping for breath before finally telling the monster about Wukong's background.
62 The monster, now aware of Sun Wukong's power, hurriedly ordered the water creatures to shut the gates tightly and fill them with mud, sand, soil, and stones. When Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujing returned for a second time to shout insults and pound on the door, the monster ignored them.
summary_zh: 妖怪逃回宫中，斑衣鳜婆告知其孙悟空的真实身份，妖怪大惊。随后妖怪下令紧闭宫门并用泥沙堵塞，拒绝八戒和沙僧的叫骂与挑战。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》
title_en: Journey to the West 18: The Great Uproar at Tongtian River
source_file: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
63 八戒和沙僧打了一阵门没有打开，只得回来向悟空说了。悟空吩咐他二人小心在河边巡逻，自己一纵身跳上云头，往南海普陀岩找观音菩萨去问底细。
64 悟空到了普陀岩，只见菩萨头不梳、脸不洗，只穿了小袄裤，光着脚，在紫竹林削竹编篮子呢！悟空急忙跑上前去问她，通天河里到底是个什么妖怪。
page_text_en:
63 Pigsy and Sandy knocked on the door for a while but couldn't open it, so they returned to tell Wukong. Wukong instructed them to carefully patrol by the riverbank, while he himself leaped onto the clouds and headed to the Southern Sea's Putuo Rock to ask Guanyin Bodhisattva for details.
64 When Wukong arrived at Putuo Rock, he saw the Bodhisattva with her hair uncombed, face unwashed, wearing only a small tunic and pants, barefoot, and chopping bamboo to weave baskets in the Purple Bamboo Grove! Wukong hurried forward to ask her, 'What exactly is the monster in the Tongtian River?'
summary_zh: 八戒和沙僧无法打开妖怪宫门，返回向孙悟空报告。孙悟空吩咐他们守在河边，自己驾云前往南海普陀岩向观音菩萨求助。到达后，他发现观音正在紫竹林削竹编篮子，便急忙上前询问通天河妖怪的真相。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》
title_en: Journey to the West 18: The Great Uproar at Tongtian River
source_file: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
那怪是我养的
一条金鱼，偷了
一朵荷花跑了。
65 菩萨一听，心里早已明白了，马上削好竹子，编了一个小篮，随着悟空，驾了彩云，直往通天河来。路上菩萨把那怪的来历告诉了悟空，原来他是菩萨养的一条金鱼，偷了一朵荷花逃出来。
66 菩萨到了通天河，用丝绦系了小篮，抛向河心，不多一会儿，提上来一尾金鱼。
page_text_en:
That monster is a golden fish I raised, who stole a lotus flower and ran away.
65 The Bodhisattva, upon hearing this, immediately understood. She quickly peeled bamboo, wove a small basket, and, accompanied by Wukong, rode on a rainbow cloud straight to the Tongtian River. Along the way, the Bodhisattva told Wukong the monster's origin: he was a golden fish she raised, who had stolen a lotus flower and fled.
66 The Bodhisattva arrived at the Tongtian River, tied the small basket with a silk ribbon, threw it into the river's center, and in no time, pulled up a golden fish.
summary_zh: 观音菩萨得知通天河妖怪是她所养的金鱼后，立即削竹编篮，与孙悟空一同前往通天河。她将篮子抛入河中，很快便钓上了一条金鱼。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》
title_en: Journey to the West 18: The Great Uproar at Tongtian River
source_file: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
67 菩萨收了那怪走了，悟空兄弟三人连忙又进入水底宫里，揭开石匣，救了唐僧。
68 随后，唐僧师徒又到陈家庄来取行李马匹，与陈澄、陈清和众百姓辞行。庄上人家依依不舍地送到河边，又争着出船出人，要渡唐僧师徒过河。
page_text_en:
67 The Bodhisattva took away the monster. Wukong and his two brothers hurriedly entered the underwater palace again, opened the stone chest, and rescued Tang Sanzang.
68 Afterwards, the Tang monk and his disciples returned to Chenjia Village to collect their luggage and horses, bidding farewell to Chen Cheng, Chen Qing, and the villagers. The villagers, reluctant to part, saw them off to the riverbank, eagerly offering boats and manpower to ferry the Tang monk and his disciples across the river.
summary_zh: 观音菩萨收走妖怪后，孙悟空兄弟三人进入水底宫殿救出唐僧；随后师徒四人返回陈家庄取行李马匹，与村民依依惜别，村民争相送行并愿帮忙渡河。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》
title_en: Journey to the West 18: The Great Uproar at Tongtian River
source_file: 连环画《西游记18：大闹通天河》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
69 悟空抢先到了岸边，忽然水里涌出一个老鼋，悟空正抢棍要打，老鼋却说了话：‘那怪霸占我的宅子多年，幸亏大圣除怪，使我有了安身之处。我是来谢恩的。’
70 老鼋要驮唐僧师徒过河，悟空看出它是诚意，就引了师父、师弟上来，自己用虎筋条作了缰绳拉住鼋头，向西走去，陈家庄百姓感谢悟空等救人除妖，直送到望不见人才回村去了。要知后事如何，请看《金兜洞》。
page_text_en:
69 Wukong arrived at the shore first, when suddenly an old turtle emerged from the water. Wukong was about to strike it with his staff, but the turtle spoke: 'That monster had occupied my home for many years. Thanks to you, Great Sage, for eliminating the demon, I now have a place to live. I am here to thank you.'
70 The old turtle offered to carry Master Tang and his disciples across the river. Wukong saw its sincerity, so he brought his master and disciples onto its back, tied its head with a rope made from tiger tendons, and they set off westward. The villagers of Chenjiazhuang thanked Wukong and his companions for saving them from the demon, and saw them off until they were out of sight before returning to their village. To learn what happens next, please read 'The Golden Horn Cave'.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在岸边遇到老鼋，老鼋感谢他除掉妖怪，得以安身。随后老鼋驮唐僧师徒过河，孙悟空用虎筋条作缰绳，陈家庄百姓送行至不见人影。
